text:
maria: Hey team — Acme POC is blocked on onboarding. Their IdP is sending NameID as 'persistent' and SCIM calls from our connector are returning 400 because groups come back empty. They need Dedicated pool access for throughput next week. Can we triage?
ajay: Can you paste the SAML assertion snippet? nameID format mismatch is common.
maria: Here's an example from the IdP (they sanitized org values):
```xml
<saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent\">abc123xyz</saml:NameID>
```
They say changing to emailAddress breaks other tooling.
kevin: SCIM side — what are the payloads? If groups are empty maybe they aren't mapping groupMembership or the SCIM filter param is different.
maria: SCIM resp (truncated):
```json
{
  \"Resources\": [
    {
      \"displayName\": \"Engineering\",
      \"members\": []  // expected 3 members but empty array returned
    }
  ]
}
```
stefan: sounds like the IdP is returning groupClaims as a string not array or groups are in a custom claim. Ask their IdP admin to enable 'groups' as multivalued claim or push group sync via SCIM with full member attribute.
nicole: For immediate unblock we can: 1) issue a temporary Hosted API key scoped to the POC (48h expiry) so devs can continue integration without SAML, 2) open infra ticket to provision a Dedicated pool but that takes 3–5 business days, 3) request IdP admin change NameID to emailAddress or add email as additional attribute in assertion.
maria: Customer asked about security — will a temporary API key be allowed? They need it in their security questionnaire to sign off.
stefan: Short answer — yes if we scope it and add audit log + short TTL. I'll approve if PS adds note in questionnaire. Also add MFA requirement on the IdP side for SSO flow.
deploy-bot: [notice] New temporary API key created: poc-acme-temp-xxxx (expires in 48h). Owner: nicole.
infra-oncall: On the Dedicated pool front — I can reserve GPU nodes and estimate ready-by 3 business days if ticket is created today and networking (customer VPC peering) is straightforward. If they want Private/VPC deployment on-prem, that's longer (2–3 weeks).
kevin: On SCIM egress: confirm the customer firewall allows outbound to our SCIM endpoint IPs. If they're blocking or doing IP allowlist, we can provide static egress IPs but need a ticket to infra for allocation.
maria: I'm going to ask them for: 1) SAML assertion with the email claim, 2) IdP config screenshot for group claim type, 3) their firewall rules for SCIM. I'll share the temporary API key and the dedicated timeline.
nicole: I'll draft the security QA note and include audit logs and key TTL. Taking ownership of the API key handoff and will coordinate with Stef for approval.
stefan: I'll email security sign-off to sales-thread once QA note is attached.
maria: Thanks — I'll update the customer and post back once IdP screenshots arrive. :thumbsup:
